kind: synthetic software baseline; not detection accuracy or capacity certification

measurement.timed: store.create including preflight; HTTP in-process queries, local/global SHAP, export
measurement.excluded: startup imports, model fitting/loading, input generation, export verification, deletion; HTTP upload excluded unless requested
measurement.cold_start: first local SHAP includes lazy SHAP imports/JIT; each case uses a fresh process
measurement.python_peak: tracemalloc during timed stages; includes tracing overhead in elapsed time
measurement.rss_peak: OS process lifetime high-water RSS, includes imports and model loading; not a delta
measurement.storage: completed SQLite files; upload bytes also reserved by service quota; benchmark export file outside server quota
measurement.transport: TestClient buffers uploads/responses; bounded-export uses server lease directly and writes a client file incrementally
measurement.throughput: rows / ingestion seconds; total_seconds also includes result access
